{"model":"gpt-5.4-mini","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"## Tool Use

Use the provided tool `extracted_data` to extract correct and accurate structured data from the input.

Tool purpose: Function call based on user instructions.

Call the tool with the best supported arguments for the requested extraction."},{"role":"user","content":"    <problem>
    What is the area of the square with the four vertices at (-2, 2), (2, -2), (-2, -6), and (-6, -2)?
    </problem>
    
    Relevant Problems: Recall 3 relevant and
    distinct problems. For each problem, describe
    it and explain the solution before solving
    the problem    "}],"max_completion_tokens":1024,"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"extracted_data","description":"Function call based on user instructions.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"relevantProblems":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","description":"Correctly extract items of type: Problem","properties":{"problemExplanation":{"type":"string"},"solution":{"type":"string"}},"required":["problemExplanation","solution"],"additionalProperties":false}},"problemSolution":{"type":"object","properties":{"problemExplanation":{"type":"string"},"solution":{"type":"string"}},"required":["problemExplanation","solution"],"additionalProperties":false},"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["relevantProblems","problemSolution","answer"],"additionalProperties":false}}}],"tool_choice":{"type":"function","function":{"name":"extracted_data"}}}
